overviewHtml:
Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek

The Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek is one of the most spectacular trekking adventures in Nepal, combining the legendary Everest Base Camp Trek with the breathtaking turquoise Gokyo Chola Pass Everest Base Camp Trek. This remarkable Everest Base Camp via Gokyo Lakes Trek offers stunning Himalayan scenery, authentic Sherpa culture, glacier crossings, and panoramic mountain viewpoints.

This adventurous Cho La Pass Trek Nepal itinerary is ideal for trekkers seeking a more challenging and rewarding alternative to the standard Everest Base Camp trek. The trail passes through the beautiful Gokyo Valley Trek, crosses the high-altitude Cho La Pass (5,420m), and continues toward Everest Base Camp and Kala Patthar for unforgettable views of Mount Everest.

The Gokyo Cho La Pass Everest Base Camp Trek is considered one of the best Everest adventure treks in Nepal, combining remote mountain landscapes, pristine alpine lakes, and iconic Everest trekking highlights into one extraordinary journey.

Trip Highlights

  • Explore the legendary Everest Base Camp (5,364m)
  • Cross the thrilling Cho La Pass (5,420m)
  • Visit the stunning turquoise Gokyo Lakes
  • Hike to Gokyo Ri for panoramic Everest Himalayan views
  • Experience the best Everest panoramic trekking route
  • Discover authentic Sherpa villages and Buddhist monasteries
  • Trek through Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
  • Enjoy breathtaking views of Everest, Lhotse, Nuptse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu
  • Experience a classic tea house trek in the Everest region
  • Witness the dramatic Khumbu Glacier and icefall

Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek Overview

The Everest Base Camp Gokyo Lake Trek begins with a scenic flight to Lukla, followed by trekking through picturesque Sherpa villages including Namche Bazaar, Dole, Machhermo, and Gokyo. After exploring the beautiful Gokyo Lakes and climbing Gokyo Ri, the route crosses the challenging Cho La Pass before joining the classic Everest Base Camp trail.

This incredible Everest Base Camp and Gokyo Trek combines adventure, natural beauty, and cultural immersion. Trekkers enjoy quieter trails in the Gokyo Valley while experiencing the iconic Everest Base Camp route and Kala Patthar viewpoint.

The trek is perfect for adventurous travelers looking for a complete Everest Base Camp Circuit Trek with fewer crowds and more diverse landscapes.

Difficulty Level of Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Trek

The EBC Cho La Pass Trek is considered a challenging high-altitude trek suitable for physically fit trekkers with good endurance. Crossing Cho La Pass requires stamina and proper acclimatization due to steep ascents, rocky trails, and glacier sections.

Trekkers should prepare for long walking days and changing Himalayan weather conditions. Previous trekking experience is beneficial but not mandatory; with proper preparation and guidance, it is possible to trek.

Best Time for Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Trek

The best season for the Cho La Pass Trek in Nepal is during:

Spring (March to May)

  • Clear skies and stable weather
  • Blooming rhododendron forests
  • Excellent mountain visibility

Autumn (September to November)

  • Best trekking conditions
  • Crisp mountain views
  • Stable temperatures and dry trails

Winter trekking is possible, but Cho La Pass may become difficult due to snow and ice.

Cho La Pass Altitude

The Cho La Pass stands at an altitude of 5,420 meters (17,782 feet), making it one of the most exciting high-pass trekking adventures in Nepal.

Proper acclimatization is essential to complete this high-altitude Himalayan crossing safely.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu Airport 1,400m / 4,593ft
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, our representative from Nepal Unique Treks will warmly welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. Kathmandu,

itinerary.title: Trek Gear Preparation and Acclimatization in Kathmandu, 1,400m / 4,593ft
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will attend a detailed trek briefing with your guide. During the meeting, you will discuss the complete Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek itinerary, safety information, altitude awareness, and equipment checklist. Your trekking guide will help inspect your equipment and arrange any missing trekking gear required for the high-altitude Everest adventure trek in Nepal. Proper preparation before starting the Everest Base Camp via Gokyo Lakes Trek is essential for a safe and enjoyable trekking experience.

itinerary.title: Drive to Ramechhap, Fly to Lukla (2,860m) & Trek to Phakding (2,610m) 8 km, 4 hrs
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, you will drive from Kathmandu to Ramechhap Airport before taking a scenic mountain flight to Lukla, the gateway to Everest trekking in Nepal. The dramatic Himalayan flight offers incredible views of snow-capped peaks and deep valleys. After arriving in Lukla, the trek officially begins. The trail descends gradually through beautiful Sherpa villages, prayer wheels, mani walls, and suspension bridges alongside the Dudh Koshi River before reaching Phakding.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar (3,440m) 3,440m / 11,286ft, 12 km, 7/8 hrs
itinerary.description: Today’s trek follows the Dudh Koshi River through pine forests and charming Sherpa settlements. You will cross several iconic suspension bridges, including the famous Hillary Suspension Bridge. After entering Sagarmatha National Park at Monjo, the trail climbs steeply toward Namche Bazaar, the vibrant Sherpa capital of the Everest region. Along the route, weather permitting, trekkers enjoy their first distant view of Mount Everest.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day in Namche Bazaar, 3,440m / 11,286ft, 4/5 hrs
itinerary.description: Acclimatization is extremely important during the Everest Base Camp, Cho La Pass, and Gokyo Trek. To help your body adjust to a higher altitude, you will take a short acclimatization hike to the Everest View Hotel or nearby viewpoints. The hike offers spectacular panoramic views of Everest, Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Thamserku. After returning to Namche, you can explore local bakeries, museums, trekking shops, and Sherpa culture.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tengboche Monastery Altitude: 3,867m / 12,687ft Trek Distance: 10 km Trek Duration: 5–6 hrs
itinerary.description: The trail follows a scenic ridge with incredible Himalayan panoramas before descending to the Dudh Koshi River and climbing through rhododendron forests to Tengboche. Tengboche Monastery is the largest and most famous monastery in the Everest region, surrounded by spectacular mountain scenery including Ama Dablam and Everest. This is one of the most beautiful days on the Everest panoramic trekking route.

itinerary.title: Trek to Dingboche Altitude: 4,410m / 14,468ft Trek Distance: 11 km Trek Duration: 5 hrs
itinerary.description: Today’s trek gradually climbs through Pangboche village and alpine landscapes toward Dingboche. The scenery becomes more rugged as you gain altitude. Dingboche is a beautiful Himalayan settlement surrounded by towering peaks and stone-walled fields. Trekkers enjoy excellent views of Ama Dablam, Thamsherku, Island Peak, and Lhotse along the route.

itinerary.title: Hike to Nagarjun Hill – Acclimatization Day Highest Altitude: 5,100m / 16,732ft Hiking Duration: 5 hrs
itinerary.description: Today is another important acclimatization day during the Everest Base Camp, Cho La Pass Trek. Hike to Nagarjun Hill above Dingboche for breathtaking panoramic views of Makalu, Lhotse, Ama Dablam, and surrounding Himalayan peaks. After the hike, return to Dingboche for rest and preparation for higher elevations.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lobuche Altitude: 4,910m / 16,109ft Trek Distance: 8 km Trek Duration: 5 hrs
itinerary.description: The trail climbs gradually along the Khumbu Glacier moraine while offering dramatic mountain views. Pass the Everest Memorial Site at Thukla, dedicated to climbers who lost their lives on Everest expeditions. Continue trekking to Lobuche, a small settlement surrounded by towering Himalayan peaks.

itinerary.title: Trek to Everest Base Camp Everest Base Camp Altitude: 5,364m / 17,598ft Gorakshep Altitude: 5,164m / 16,942ft Trek Distance: 15 km Trek Duration: 8 hrs
itinerary.description: Today is the highlight of the Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Trekking adventure. Trek alongside the Khumbu Glacier to Gorakshep before continuing to the legendary Everest Base Camp. Enjoy unforgettable views of the Khumbu Icefall and surrounding Himalayan giants. After celebrating at Everest Base Camp, return to Gorakshep for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hike to Kala Patthar & Trek to Dzongla Kala Patthar Altitude: 5,550m / 18,208ft Dzongla Altitude: 4,830m / 15,846ft Trek Duration: 6–7 hrs
itinerary.description: Early morning hike to Kala Patthar, the best viewpoint for panoramic sunrise views of Mount Everest, Nuptse, and Pumori. After returning to Gorakshep for breakfast, descend and continue toward Dzongla, preparing for the challenging Cho La Pass crossing.

itinerary.title: Trek to Dragnak via Cho La Pass Cho La Pass Altitude: 5,420m / 17,782ft Dragnak Altitude: 4,700m / 15,420ft Trek Distance: 10 km Trek Duration: 7 hrs
itinerary.description: One of the most adventurous days of the high pass trekking Nepal experience. Cross the icy and rocky Cho La Pass while enjoying magnificent Himalayan scenery. The trail involves glacier crossings, steep ascents, and dramatic landscapes before descending toward Dragnak. This challenging section makes the Everest Base Camp Trek with Cho La Pass one of the best adventure treks in Nepal.

itinerary.title: Trek to Gokyo Lakes Altitude: 4,790m / 15,715ft Trek Distance: 4 km Trek Duration: 2–3 hrs
itinerary.description: Cross the Ngozumpa Glacier, the largest glacier in Nepal, before arriving at the beautiful turquoise Gokyo Lakes. The Gokyo Valley is one of the most scenic destinations in the Everest region, surrounded by pristine lakes and snow-capped mountains.

itinerary.title: Hike to Gokyo Ri & Trek to Dole Gokyo Ri Altitude: 5,483m / 17,989ft Dole Altitude: 4,200m / 13,780ft Trek Duration: 6–7 hrs
itinerary.description: Early morning hike to Gokyo Ri for one of the finest panoramic mountain views in Nepal. From the summit, enjoy breathtaking views of Everest, Cho Oyu, Makalu, and the entire Gokyo Valley. After descending, continue trekking downhill toward Dole.

itinerary.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar Altitude: 3,440m / 11,286ft Trek Distance: 13 km Trek Duration: 6 hrs
itinerary.description: Descend through rhododendron forests, yak pastures, and Sherpa villages while enjoying final Himalayan views. Return to the bustling mountain town of Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Trek to Lukla Altitude: 2,840m / 9,317ft Trek Distance: 18 km Trek Duration: 6–7 hrs
itinerary.description: The final trekking day follows the Dudh Koshi River through forests and traditional villages before reaching Lukla. Celebrate the successful completion of the Gokyo Cho La Pass Everest Base Camp Trek with your trekking crew.

itinerary.title: Fly from Lukla to Ramechhap & Drive to Kathmandu 5/6 hrs, 1400 m
itinerary.description: Take an early morning flight from Lukla to Ramechhap, followed by a scenic drive back to Kathmandu. Enjoy your final evening in Nepal and celebrate your unforgettable Himalayan adventure.

itinerary.title: Departure to International Airport, 1,345m / 4,413ft
itinerary.description: Today, you have free time to walk around Thamel and buy some handicrafts as a gift for your family and friends. Nepal Unique Treks staff will drop you at the airport three hours before your scheduled flight. We hope you had a great adventure trekking with us. Thank you, and have a safe journey home.

liveFaqs.question: How difficult is the Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: The Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek is considered a challenging high-altitude trek in Nepal. The trek involves long walking days, steep ascents, glacier crossings, and crossing the Cho La Pass at 5,420m. Good physical fitness and proper acclimatization are essential for completing this adventure safely.

liveFaqs.question: How long is the Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek itinerary?
liveFaqs.answer: The standard Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek itinerary usually takes 16 to 18 days, including acclimatization days in Namche Bazaar and Dingboche. The itinerary may vary depending on weather conditions and trekking pace.

liveFaqs.question: What is the best time for Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: The best time for the Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Trek is during the spring season (March to May) and autumn season (September to November). These months offer clear mountain views, stable weather, and ideal trekking conditions in the Everest region.

liveFaqs.question: Is Cho La Pass dangerous?
liveFaqs.answer: Cho La Pass is one of the most adventurous sections of the Cho La Pass Trek in Nepal. The trail can be icy, snowy, and rocky, especially during winter or after snowfall. However, with experienced guides, proper acclimatization, and suitable trekking gear, the pass can be crossed safely.

liveFaqs.question: What is the altitude of Cho La Pass?
liveFaqs.answer: The Cho La Pass altitude is 5,420 meters (17,782 feet) above sea level, making it one of the famous high mountain passes in the Everest region.

liveFaqs.question: Do I need previous trekking experience for the EBC Cho La Pass Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Previous trekking experience is helpful but not mandatory for the EBC Cho La Pass Trek. Trekkers should have good physical fitness, stamina, and mental preparation for high-altitude trekking in Nepal.

liveFaqs.question: What permits are required for the Everest Base Camp Gokyo Lake Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Trekkers need: Sagarmatha National Park Permit Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Permit These permits are mandatory for the Everest Base Camp Gokyo Lake Trek.

liveFaqs.question: What accommodation is available during the trek?
liveFaqs.answer: The trek uses traditional tea house accommodation in the Everest region. Tea houses provide basic but comfortable rooms, meals, hot drinks, and warm hospitality from local Sherpa families.

liveFaqs.question: Is altitude sickness common during the Everest Base Camp and Gokyo Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Altitude sickness can affect trekkers above 3,000 meters. Proper acclimatization, slow ascent, hydration, and experienced guides help reduce the risk during the Everest Base Camp and Gokyo Trek.

liveFaqs.question: How cold does it get during the trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Temperatures vary by season and altitude. At higher elevations such as Gorakshep, Cho La Pass, and Gokyo, temperatures can drop below freezing, especially at night and early morning.

liveFaqs.question: What is the maximum altitude during the Everest Base Camp Trek with Cho La Pass?
liveFaqs.answer: The highest point of the trek is Kala Patthar at 5,550m (18,208ft), followed by Cho La Pass at 5,420m.

liveFaqs.question: Can beginners do the Everest Base Camp via Gokyo Lakes Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes, beginners with good fitness and determination can complete the Everest Base Camp via the Gokyo Lakes Trek with proper preparation and support from experienced trekking guides.

liveFaqs.question: What are the major highlights of the Gokyo Cho La Pass Everest Base Camp Trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Major highlights include: Everest Base Camp Kala Patthar sunrise viewpoint Cho La Pass crossing Gokyo Lakes Gokyo Ri hike Sherpa culture Sagarmatha National Park Khumbu Glacier views

liveFaqs.question: Is travel insurance necessary for Everest trekking in Nepal?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes, comprehensive travel insurance is highly recommended for the Everest trek in Nepal. Insurance should cover high-altitude trekking, helicopter evacuation, medical emergencies, and flight cancellations.

liveFaqs.question: What kind of food is available during the trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Tea houses offer a variety of meals, including: Dal Bhat Noodles Fried rice Pasta Soups Pancakes Tea and coffee Vegetarian meals are widely available during the tea house trek in the Everest region.

liveFaqs.question: How much does the Everest Base Camp Cho La Pass Gokyo Trek cost?
liveFaqs.answer: The Everest trekking cost depends on trek duration, services, group size, accommodation standard, and season. Most guided trekking packages include permits, flights, accommodation, meals, guide, and porter services.

liveFaqs.question: Is WiFi and electricity available during the trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Most tea houses offer WiFi and charging facilities for an additional cost. Connectivity may become limited at higher elevations.

liveFaqs.question: Why is the Gokyo Lakes and Everest Base Camp Trek popular?
liveFaqs.answer: The Gokyo Lakes and Everest Base Camp Trek is popular because it combines Everest Base Camp, stunning turquoise lakes, panoramic Himalayan viewpoints, glacier crossings, and quieter trekking trails into one unforgettable Himalayan adventure.

liveFaqs.question: What should I pack for the Everest Adventure Trek Nepal?
liveFaqs.answer: Important trekking gear includes: Down jacket Sleeping bag Waterproof trekking boots Warm layers Gloves and a hat Trekking poles Sunglasses Water purification tablets Personal first aid kit Proper gear is essential for a successful Everest Adventure Trek Nepal experience.
